'''Varlax''' were a<ref name="Codex" /> [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]]<ref name="Sentience" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] of creature [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Codex" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="Onderon">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Onderon}}</ref> Varlax were predatory creatures, closely related to the similar [[Orlax]] species found on Onderon, although the Varlax species delivered a powerful [[Poison/Legends|hemotoxic]] venom through their large lower tusks. The venom was known to be particularly painful by Onderon's [[Onderonian/Legends|natives]], and Varlax attacks rarely left any survivors.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Varlax were mentioned in the Codex entry for the Orlax in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']],<ref name="Codex" /> a Digital Expansion released in [[2019]] for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10222019/game-update-6.0-onslaught|text=Game Update 6.0: Onslaught Patch Notes}}</ref>
